title: Yani Neko

thread.title: Chainsmoker Cat - Yani Neko - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: The finale was widely seen as energetic, funny, high-effort, and representative of the show's distinctive absurd style.
Several viewers praised the ensemble cast and said they would miss the characters, especially Kansai.
Some commenters considered the series a surprise favorite and hoped for another season.
Viewers appreciated the unusual blend of humor and darker or more grounded material, while acknowledging that the crude, raunchy tone would not suit everyone.

title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: The finale and series were widely praised for blending horror, tragedy, comedy, supernatural elements, and slice-of-life material effectively.
Many commenters found the conclusion emotionally satisfying and considered the show an unexpected favorite or standout of the season.
The central character relationships were repeatedly described as endearing, especially the interactions among Dara and the two children.
Several viewers enjoyed the finale's action and found the climactic confrontation exciting or satisfying.
Some viewers thought the confrontation was too brief, while others felt its short length worked because the episode returned quickly to the show's comedic rhythm.
A manga reader called the adaptation surprisingly good overall but noted some questionable adaptation choices.
Some commenters were disappointed that certain supporting characters and longer-running plot elements received little attention in the finale.
A recurring complaint was the lack of a second-season announcement, along with disappointment about not seeing the expected swimsuit presentation.
